column1: # M3-ASSY-R11 U1 (TFBGA-100, (24, 28), 0.8 mm) escape table (stage C1b, D-R11-44; re-planned D-R11-49; pinned, reviewed). One row per used
# ball (pin_table.tsv r11_net not NC). state: routed = the escape copper is on the board; open = no escape copper yet
# (an open item of stageC1b.md, the note says why). path: the layers from the ball to the field boundary (F = F.Cu only,
# F-In3 / F-B = a via at (via_x, via_y) and the named layer, F-plane = a rail ball's dog-bone to its plane). exit: the side
# of U1's courtyard x 19.38-28.62, y 23.38-32.62 the escape crosses (N / S / W / E; P a rail; U a target inside the
# field), layer the copper layer it crosses on, slot the crossing coordinate along that side (mm). target: the escape's
# first pad (tx, ty its centre). m3_design/r11_escape_check.py proves the table and checks it against the copper.
